$Comment: What the Great Turkey's hard daily Claim (Rewards/Harvest_Feast/Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Daily_Hard)
pays, the bigger Claim on the hard way in, for the first hard win each day:
Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Daily.json's rolls at better amounts and odds. Every roll is read on its own:
the first two always pay, the last three are chances on top. The Claim keeps each roll a player wins with a
chance equal to their share of the fight.
The first roll pays Harvest Coins and festival tokens through the Currency reward kind, the second two of
Martha's Turkey Pies, and the last a better chance at two pumpkin pies. Favor is not here: favor rides a
quest's or a contract's own Rewards, never a pay table. Mmo_Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Daily_Hard.json
adds Defense XP where MMO Skill Tree runs. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100. A companion mod adds rolls
with a file naming this table in ContributesTo.

The last two rolls are the Great Turkey's chase, the Great Turkey Mantle and the Golden Turkey Trophy, at the same odds as its Boss Kill Claim: that Claim rolls them on every win, so the first win each day rolls them twice. These daily rolls are kept, like the others here, with a chance equal to the player's share of the fight, so the bonus is whole for a player who fought it alone. Raise or drop the Base here to tune only the first-win-each-day bonus.
Name: Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Daily_Hard
